reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown read the New Testament's talk of the earth perishing as renovation of its form, compatible with the Old Testament's claim the earth abides forever.

sides.snippet: He laid the foundations of the earth, That it should not be moved forever.
sides.verseText: He laid the foundations of the earth, That it should not be moved forever.

sides.snippet: They will perish, but you continue. They all will grow old like a garment does.
sides.verseText: They will perish, but you continue. They all will grow old like a garment does.
